purpose: Stage One live proof: BRIX-native shared memory. Claude then Codex read one sealed FindPitches-relevant snapshot through the existing runner; their validated contributions are appended and verified in a fresh process. Two model calls.

seed.title: FindPitches: what evidence shows a UK vendor pitch is real, open to applications now, and actionable for a small trader?
seed.body: Mycelium's first mission is finding verified, available vendor pitches (markets, fairs, events) that a small UK trader can act on. This seed asks a question; it asserts nothing. Contributions should propose evidence, tests or failure modes for verifying that a listed pitch exists, is currently accepting applications, and has actionable terms (date, location, fee, how to apply), and should say what would make such a claim wrong.
